nodes.remediation: Copy the Internal Integration Secret from the integration's settings in Notion (Integrations > the integration > Configuration) and update the credential.
In Notion, open each top-level page or database to index, select the ••• menu > Connections, and add the integration. Its child pages are shared with it too.
Use the 32-character ID at the end of the page URL. Then share the page with the integration: open the page, select the ••• menu > Connections, and add the integration.
In Notion, open the integration's settings (Integrations > the integration > Capabilities) and select 'Read content'. Then share the pages to index with the integration.
Share the databases to index with the integration (••• menu > Connections). In Notion, open the integration's settings (Integrations > the integration > Capabilities) and select 'Read content'.
In Notion, open the integration's settings (Integrations > the integration > Capabilities) and select 'Read user information without email addresses'. Onyx does not need email addresses.
